attribution_limitations: Table 1 grades the patient Int-2 under the column IPSS, defined in the footnote as the International Prognostic Scoring System, while the text grades her very high risk by the revised International Prognostic Scoring System. These are two different scoring systems; both values are kept as separate included facts and no source conflict is asserted.

The table CD4 value 929 cells/mm^(3) has no printed time point and the text separately states CD4 counts above 600 cells/mm^(3) over 16 years; they are not merged and no time is inferred for the table value.

The authors hypothesize that trisomy 8 and the ASXL1 mutation could be a consequence of long-standing ART exposure leading to secondary MDS. This is hedged discussion and is not recorded as an asserted cause or a secondary MDS diagnosis.

The text lists four clones on the repeat karyotype while the Figure 1 caption for panel D names only 49,XX,+8,+10,+21; the caption shows one clone and is not a conflict. The caption also prints RUNX1 21q2 where the text prints 21q22, a print variation.

The text does not state when the second bone marrow findings or the final hematological parameters were obtained relative to the dates given; their time is left null and the 7 months later phrase is applied only to the karyotype sentence.

The age 61 years is printed in the sentence that also states the HIV diagnosis in 2002, while Table 1 lists Age/Sex 61/F with 16 years from HIV for this report. The age is recorded as the case age and is not anchored to the 2002 diagnosis.
